name: BACH_0187
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, second model agrees, 5/5 neighbors Invasive [F1]; flagged tier 2 because invasive is the top class.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%; InSitu <1% | Very large margin |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 76th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; concept model links it to invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored low overall; strongest only in region 11 · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; slightly against invasive in concept model · Validated
- **Nuclear size variation** (regions 6, 7, 10) · context · 98th percentile of reference; mean nuclear size lowest · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect classifier use. This case leans on normal lobules (0/20, Unreliable) and lymphocytes (8/20, Weak).

## Could be wrong if
- Mean nuclear size is lowest in the reference set; measured on only 3 regions.
- Region 11 scores lower (68% invasive) with benign-leaning concepts; benign tissue unconfirmed.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 10**: confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Region 11**: look for benign lobules or fat; lowest-risk region (68%).
3. **Regions 6, 7, 10**: check small nuclei with wide size variation.
